rescale_image_depthmap: rescale an image and depthmap together to a target output resolution while updating camera intrinsics
crop_image_depthmap: crop an image and depthmap using a bounding box and adjust camera intrinsics accordingly
camera_matrix_of_crop: compute the updated camera intrinsics matrix after cropping or rescaling an image
bbox_from_intrinsics_in_out: derive a crop bounding box from input and output camera intrinsics and output resolution
ImageList_class: create an ImageList to apply resize or crop operations across multiple images simultaneously
